notes:
Automatic updates and Pro activation.

- ScreenInk now checks for new builds itself, once a day and quietly. Settings > About shows the installed build, what is waiting, and installs it in place - your settings, shortcuts and activation carry over.
- Activation keys: the free tier keeps pen, highlighter, eraser and the full palette; a key adds shapes, text, spotlight, zoom, presentation cursors, fading ink, capture and custom shortcuts.
- Upgrading no longer switches "Start with Windows" back on if you had turned it off.
